name: Felix's Bucket of Bolts
summary: In Dun Morogh, Felix Whindlebolt is missing the tools he carried from Gnomeregan. Frostmane trolls seized his bucket during his flight and took it to their camps.

sections.title: A Refugee's Scattered Tools
sections.body: Felix Whindlebolt lost his tools while fleeing Gnomeregan. After the disaster against the troggs, radiation drove thousands of gnomes into Dun Morogh's freezing wilds with whatever they could carry. Felix escaped with his equipment and headed for Anvilmar, but Frostmane trolls from the crags southwest of town ambushed him. They plundered his belongings, including his bucket of bolts and parts, leaving the artisan without the materials he needed for his craft in exile.

faq.q: What is Felix's Bucket of Bolts?
faq.answer: Felix Whindlebolt's bucket holds bolts, hardware, and tinkering supplies. The exiled gnome is taking refuge in Anvilmar.
Frostmane trolls stole Felix Whindlebolt's bucket and other belongings as he fled the disaster at Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Where did the trolls take it?
faq.answer: Frostmane trolls carried the bucket to their camps in the crags southwest of Anvilmar, in Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Why is this bucket important to Felix?
faq.answer: Felix needs the bolts and parts for his craft. Gnomish refugees fled Gnomeregan with little, and basic supplies matter when an engineer or craftsman must survive and rebuild far from home.

angles.text: As a gnome, each bucket of parts saved from Gnomeregan helps refugees find a new foothold in Coldridge Valley.
As an engineer, you need basic hardware to work. A bucket of bolts matters when you are starting over in the snows of Dun Morogh.
